newsitem.title: KENYA: Nairobi bourse index adjusts on Nation bonus.
newsitem.headline: Nairobi bourse index adjusts on Nation bonus.

text.p: The Nairobi Stock Exchange 20-share index fell 51.88 points on Friday to stand at 3298.95, bourse officials said.
Turnover was posted at 17.530 million shillings on 327,216 shares from 27.749 million shillings on 571,361 on Thursday.

The Nation Printers & Publishers announced a bonus issue of one share for every two shares held. It posted a 158.56 million-shilling profit after tax for the year ended 31 December 1996 versus 195.226 million shillings in the previous year.
It blamed the fall on a 78.6 million shillings increase in interest payable to fund the group's new printing facility.
Nation gained 24 shillings to close at 140.
On other boards prices eased marginally.
Barclays Bank eased to 99.50 from 100 while Standard Chartered Bank closed at 44.75 from 44.50.
Rea Vipingo closed at 8.80 from 9 while Sasini Tea & Coffee was unchanged at 76.
Uchumi Supermarket gained 25 cents to close at 37.25 while Lonrho Motors closed at 200 from 198.
Kenya Power & Lighting was unchanged at 120 while Kenya Breweries eased to 58.50 from 60.
